about: Short plain-Hinglish sentences in chat register, one label each (positive / negative / neutral by the affect the words express). Two independent sets: 'probes1' was written first and its failures were studied while building the Hinglish lexicon, so it is a DEV set; 'probes2' was written BEFORE the lexicon existed and is only for the final number. Same single labeler as sample_hinglish_chat_labels.json; none of these sentences are in the training lines or the demo chats.
